		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = sheep_farms } pp_cplan_goods_here_farm_constructions = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sheep_farms building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = sheep_farms }
		}
	}
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_best
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_pick
}

# Location scope: a Victualling Yard level here: the next level of a standing Yard while it pays back within the
# food rule's line (pp_cplan_yard_payback), a first level where victuals cost at least their default price here.
pp_cplan_try_yard_here = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = victualling_yard } NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:victualling_yard building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		building_type:victualling_yard = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		pp_cplan_btype_data = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						pp_cplan_bt_levels > 0.5
						pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= pp_cplan_yard_payback
					}
					AND = {
						pp_cplan_bt_levels < 0.5
						pp_cplan_victuals_price_ratio >= 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_goods_here_victuals_trade_construction = yes }
				pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = victualling_yard }
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 101 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope (the province capital): a kitchen level (the province's Cookshop budget is its max level), first that can be built (one the market lacks
# the construction goods for is counted for the window, pp_cplan_note_goods).

		if = {

		}

		}
	}

		if = {

# Location scope, scope:pp_cplan_btype set: the build cost data of that building type (increase per level,
# the price factor of its construction goods here, its efficiency term here) as temporary values for
# pp_cplan_est_cost / pp_cplan_est_payback_years.
pp_cplan_btype_data = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:bund scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_drainage scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_management scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_management_convertible scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_management_improved scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:incamisana scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:irrigated_fields scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:irrigation_systems scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:jiangnan_canal_network scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:jiangnan_hill_terraces scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:khmer_baray scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:land_clearance scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:paddy_water_control scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:polders scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:qanats } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.05 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:legume_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:legume_farmstead scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:legume_model_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:legume_rotations scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:maize_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:maize_farmstead scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:maize_model_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:maize_rotations scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:millet_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:millet_farmstead scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:millet_model_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:millet_rotations scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:potato_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:potato_farmstead scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:potato_model_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:potato_rotations scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:rice_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:rice_farmstead scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:rice_model_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:rice_rotations scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:wheat_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:wheat_farmstead scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:wheat_model_farm scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:wheat_rotations } }

building_type:venetian_quarter scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:viceroyalty scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:yakata scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:yamashiro } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_foreign }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:bastion scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:castle scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:fortress scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:hexamilion_wall scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:repaired_great_wall_of_china scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:ruined_great_wall_of_china scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:star_fort scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:stockade scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:theodosian_walls } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_fort }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:brewery_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:cannons_factory scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:distiller_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:dyes_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:fine_cloth_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:firearms_factory scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:furniture_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:glass_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:iron_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:naval_supplies_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:paper_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:pottery_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:printing_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:steel_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:tannery_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:textile_mill scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:weapon_factory } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_mill }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:barcelona_royal_shipyard scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:brethren_marsh scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:clan_shipyards scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:copenhagen_dockyard scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:dock scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:dry_dock scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:grand_shipyard scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:hanseatic_shipwright_guild scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:imperial_halic_shipyards scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:naval_base scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:north_sea_shipyards scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:ribeira_das_naus scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:royal_atarazanas_seville scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:shipyard scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:venetian_arsenal } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_port }
	}
}

# Any scope, never run (pp_cplan_run calls it under always = no): declares the flags the window passes, so the

# Location scope: one level of the improvement that adds the most capacity per gold here (pp_cplan_imp_<key>),
# among those that can be built; a standing older tier is replaced once its successor is researched. One the
# market lacks the construction goods for is passed over; when nothing else is picked the location counts as
# held back for construction goods (scope:pp_cplan_ng).
pp_cplan_try_improve_here = {
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = 0.001 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = 100 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ng value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = bund } NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:bund building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } pp_cplan_imp_bund > var:pp_cplan_best }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = pp_cplan_imp_bund }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = 101 }
		}
		else = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ng value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = field_drainage } NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:field_drainage building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } pp_cplan_imp_field_drainage > var:pp_cplan_best }
		if = {

		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes }

# Location scope (a business site of scope:pp_cplan_country): the business with the best yearly return here that
# reaches the owner's line (pp_cplan_business_min_roi = 100 / years), as pp_cplan_bz_pick (a building type),
# pp_cplan_bz_roi (its return, %) and pp_cplan_bz_cost (the level's cost); none where none does. A candidate: the
# country can build it, so can this location (max level, allow, potential), a level finds its workers here
# (pp_cplan_staff), no level of it here is closed (the player or the game's Close and Open automation found it
# does not pay), and a profile here leaves its good and building category to the plan. A candidate that would be
# the best so far is taken only when the market holds its construction goods and has room for its good
# (pp_cplan_business_take: the market limit, pp_cplan_market_room), so the site moves on to its next best
# business instead of sitting idle; a site that passed one over for either reason is counted for the window
# (scope:pp_cplan_bz_go / _ml).
pp_cplan_business_pick = {
	pp_cplan_business_harvest = yes
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_free_peasants value = pp_cplan_free_peasants_here }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_bz_pick
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_bz_cost
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_bz_roi value = scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_business_min_roi }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_bz_go value = 0 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_bz_ml value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_bz_ablaq_palace }
			pp_cplan_staff = { type = burghers size = 0.25 }
			can_build_building = building_type:ablaq_palace
			NOT = { pp_lprof_has_good = { g = silk } }
			NOT = { pp_lprof_has_category = { c = government_category } }

# ---- Script time: the business order in blocks ----

# Country scope, in pp_cplan_business_refresh (scope:pp_cplan_from / _to: this pass's numbers of the order, + 100):
# the lists of the blocks of 16 numbers they fall in, and of those the locations whose turn it is and that
# are still the country's.
pp_cplan_business_walk = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_from < 116 scope:pp_cplan_to > 100 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = pp_cplan_bzb_1
			limit = { pp_cplan_business_turn = yes owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
			pp_cplan_business_turn_here = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_from < 132 scope:pp_cplan_to > 116 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = pp_cplan_bzb_2
			limit = { pp_cplan_business_turn = yes owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
			pp_cplan_business_turn_here = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_from < 148 scope:pp_cplan_to > 132 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = pp_cplan_bzb_3
			limit = { pp_cplan_business_turn = yes owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
			pp_cplan_business_turn_here = yes
		}

# Location scope, once, when the location got its number (pp_cplan_seq, + 100): on the list of its block.
pp_cplan_business_block = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = pp_cplan_numbered
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_seq <= 116 }
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = pp_cplan_bzb_1 target = scope:pp_cplan_numbered } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_seq <= 132 }
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = pp_cplan_bzb_2 target = scope:pp_cplan_numbered } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_seq <= 148 }

# ---- The market limit ----

# Location scope, scope:pp_cplan_btype set: for a business type, the market limit's step $do$ with the type's main
# good and one level's output of it: gate (pp_cplan_market_gate_good: scope:pp_cplan_mok = 0 where the market has
# no room) or add (pp_cplan_market_add_good: a level was started). Other building types: nothing.
pp_cplan_market_do = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:alum_quarry } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = alum out = 0.51 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:alum_works } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = alum out = 0.758 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:amber_collector } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = amber out = 0.13 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:amber_diggings } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = amber out = 0.256 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:brewery } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = beer out = 0.849 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:beer_workshop } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = beer out = 1.776 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:brewery_manufactory } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = beer out = 3.728 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:brewery_mill } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = beer out = 8.944 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:forest_village } }
		pp_cplan_market_$do$_good = { g = beeswax out = 0.189 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:scriptorium } }

# Building scope, in pp_cplan_market_load's one walk over a market (scope:pp_cplan_this_market = its centre,
# scope:pp_cplan_uc_levels = this building's levels under construction): a business type adds its levels x one
# level's output to its main good's count there. Other building types: nothing.
pp_cplan_market_count_building = {
	if = {
		limit = { building_type = building_type:alum_quarry }
		scope:pp_cplan_this_market = { pp_cplan_market_count_add = { g = alum out = 0.51 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { building_type = building_type:alum_works }
		scope:pp_cplan_this_market = { pp_cplan_market_count_add = { g = alum out = 0.758 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { building_type = building_type:amber_collector }
		scope:pp_cplan_this_market = { pp_cplan_market_count_add = { g = amber out = 0.13 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { building_type = building_type:amber_diggings }
		scope:pp_cplan_this_market = { pp_cplan_market_count_add = { g = amber out = 0.256 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { building_type = building_type:brewery }
		scope:pp_cplan_this_market = { pp_cplan_market_count_add = { g = beer out = 0.849 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { building_type = building_type:beer_workshop }
		scope:pp_cplan_this_market = { pp_cplan_market_count_add = { g = beer out = 1.776 } }
	}

# ---- Budgets that save (pp_cplan_run; the amounts are script values, pp_cplan_purse_next_<why> ...) ----

# Country scope, at the start of the pass: a group that does not count gives its purse back, the purses shrink
# alike when they hold more than the gold above the reserve, and the gold in no purse yet is shared by the
# weights. pp_cplan_in_<why> keeps what the group received for this pass (its part and what was handed on to it
# at the end of the last pass): the business group counts its time to save by it. What each group saved for
# starts afresh: the pass finds it again.
pp_cplan_purses_fill = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_105 value = pp_cplan_purse_next_105 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_105 value = { value = pp_cplan_purse_new_105 add = pp_cplan_hand_n_105 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_101 value = pp_cplan_purse_next_101 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_101 value = { value = pp_cplan_purse_new_101 add = pp_cplan_hand_n_101 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_102 value = pp_cplan_purse_next_102 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_102 value = { value = pp_cplan_purse_new_102 add = pp_cplan_hand_n_102 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_106 value = pp_cplan_purse_next_106 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_106 value = { value = pp_cplan_purse_new_106 add = pp_cplan_hand_n_106 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_103 value = pp_cplan_purse_next_103 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_103 value = { value = pp_cplan_purse_new_103 add = pp_cplan_hand_n_103 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_107 value = pp_cplan_purse_next_107 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_107 value = { value = pp_cplan_purse_new_107 add = pp_cplan_hand_n_107 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_105 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_105 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_in_105 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_105 add = 100 } }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_hand_105
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_101 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_101 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_in_101 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_101 add = 100 } }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_hand_101
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_102 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_102 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_in_102 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_102 add = 100 } }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_hand_102
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_106 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_106 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_in_106 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_106 add = 100 } }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_hand_106
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_103 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_103 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_in_103 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_103 add = 100 } }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_hand_103
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_107 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_107 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_in_107 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_107 add = 100 } }
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_hand_107
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_profiles_cw > 0 } }
		pp_cplan_save_clear = { why = 105 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_food_w > 0 } }
		pp_cplan_save_clear = { why = 101 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_logistics_w > 0 } }
		pp_cplan_save_clear = { why = 102 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_improve_w > 0 } }
		pp_cplan_save_clear = { why = 106 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_business_w > 0 } }
		pp_cplan_save_clear = { why = 103 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_country_cw > 0 } }
		pp_cplan_save_clear = { why = 107 }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_save_rank_107
	}
}

# Country scope, at the end of the pass: every group that ran and saves for nothing hands what is left of its
# purse to the groups that do save, by their weights (next month's money). While no group saves, nothing moves.
pp_cplan_purses_hand_on = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_105 value = pp_cplan_hand_next_105 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_105 value = pp_cplan_hand_get_105 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_101 value = pp_cplan_hand_next_101 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_101 value = pp_cplan_hand_get_101 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_102 value = pp_cplan_hand_next_102 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_102 value = pp_cplan_hand_get_102 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_106 value = pp_cplan_hand_next_106 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_106 value = pp_cplan_hand_get_106 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_103 value = pp_cplan_hand_next_103 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_103 value = pp_cplan_hand_get_103 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_np_107 value = pp_cplan_hand_next_107 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ni_107 value = pp_cplan_hand_get_107 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_105 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_105 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_hand_105 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_105 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_101 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_101 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_hand_101 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_101 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_102 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_102 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_hand_102 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_102 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_106 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_106 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_hand_106 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_106 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_103 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_103 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_hand_103 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_103 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_purse_107 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_np_107 add = 100 } }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_hand_107 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_ni_107 add = 100 } }
}

# ---- The window's detail panes (rules never read these) ----

# Country scope: the profiles group looks: what its last look left for the window is gone (its list of
# constructions and their entries on the locations, its numbers, its situation).
pp_cplan_stats_reset_105 = {
	every_in_list = {
		variable = pp_cplan_log_105
		pp_cplan_log_clear = { why = 105 }
	}
	clear_variable_list = pp_cplan_log_105
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dhad_105 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dspent_105 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dn_105 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dwait_105 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dwn_105 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dgo_105 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dml_105 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_locs value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st1 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st2 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st3 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st4 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st5 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st6 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st7 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st8 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st9 value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_ds_profiles_st10 value = 100 }
}
